title: I'm back with what I promised - Pixelfork.ai
author: shottycoin
selftext:
we are finally opening Pixelfork to everybody. It's been a long journey. we did a lot of optimization for Pixelfork to make it best AI Game Builder platform out there. and it's just the beggining. Would love to hear your feedbacks. I also drop a game made with pixelfork here. 

Game: [https://pixelfork.ai/publish/f4249f22-45af-4451-a57e-63b1e4b081f2](https://pixelfork.ai/publish/f4249f22-45af-4451-a57e-63b1e4b081f2)

Platform: [https://pixelfork.ai](https://pixelfork.ai)

Authors of used assets  
[https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/](https://pixelfrog-assets.itch.io/)  
[https://gabry-corti.itch.io/](https://gabry-corti.itch.io/)

  
IMPORTANT NOTE: It's too addictive to build a game with pixelfork)

waiting for your brutally honest feedbacks :)

comments.author: Leather_Tomorrow4993
comments.body: is this game really made with this platform? i tried the platform but it created basic games. If so how can i proceede to make a game like this?

replies.author: GRCphotography
replies.body: if this game was made with it, then it should be a you tube tutorial showing us. So we know how to use it?

replies.author: shottycoin
replies.body: I will definitely record a youtube tutorial :)

replies.author: shottycoin
replies.body: Yes. It's created with Pixelfork. I used assets from itch.io. Authors name stated on my post. I will share a youtube tutorial how did I created it.

comments.author: QseanRay
comments.body: What's the benefit of using your platform versus cursor or copilot?

replies.author: shottycoin
replies.body: We focused on game development only. we enable you to deploy your game instantly on our cloud. Supabase connection coming soon. Also we will add a feature for asset generation where you will be able to generate characters, animate them, rotate character angle from single frame and etc. A lot of gamedev spesific features coming soon. This is why we would love to hear your feedbacks to make it the best AI Gamedev platform on the internet.

replies.author: QseanRay
replies.body:
Deploying instantly isn't really a benefit unless you're just playing around for fun, and same thing with asset generation, I would ask why would I use your site instead of a stand alone product like retro diffusion.

I still don't see what the value proposition is here

replies.author: shottycoin
replies.body: retro diffusion is for image generation. doesn't write code. On your first comment you compared us with Cursor/Copilot. It was a right comparison :)

replies.author: QseanRay
replies.body: Yeah but you haven't said what you're offering that cursor/copilot doesn't already do.

comments.author: xuesim
comments.body: How does this platform find images and sound to use, is that created using AI automatically too?

comments.author: FamouslyDefault
comments.body: Don’t listen to the haters man, every tool has to start somewhere

comments.author: Oisincadd
comments.body: What engine are yall building with?

comments.author: IfnotFr
comments.body: Seems like a great tool for prototyping ideas quickly. Optimization work definitely shows.
